events.continuity_hook: Carry the chosen date window and Portland round trip together with two viable lodging sequences, verified sleeping arrangements for three travelers, taxes and fees, cancellation dates, parking details, and drive times between Portland, the northern coast, the central coast, and the airport hotel.
events.interaction_goal: Compare complete eight-night lodging totals, confirm that every room can sleep all three family members, and narrow each stop to a practical hotel without reserving anything.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus and his family have selected the earlier date window and a round trip through Portland because the one-way airport plan costs substantially more for three fares and the rental car. They now need eight lodging nights, with three near Cannon Beach, four around Newport or Yachats, and a final night near Portland airport; several attractive coastal listings show only one bed or do not clearly state whether a 12-year-old is included in the quoted occupancy.

events.continuity_hook: Retain the three-night Cannon Beach and four-night Yachats candidates with confirmed occupancy, nightly and full-stay totals, cancellation deadlines, parking terms, and the remaining two-queen airport-hotel options for the final night.
events.interaction_goal: Verify the four-night minimum and sofa-bed arrangement, replace the unsuitable airport room, and settle the complete lodging sequence before booking.
events.scenario_brief: The preferred Cannon Beach property is available for only the first three nights, fitting the planned north-to-south route, while the leading Yachats option requires a four-night minimum and has a sofa bed that the property confirms is suitable for the son. The early flight home still makes an airport hotel sensible for night eight, but its least expensive room has one king and no additional sleeping surface.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the completed confirmations for all eight nights, room configurations and occupancy for three, final totals and fees, cancellation deadlines, parking information, check-in times, and the north-to-south lodging sequence.
events.interaction_goal: Reprice the three-property itinerary, verify dates and room arrangements, and reserve all eight lodging nights if the sequence still fits the selected route.
events.scenario_brief: All three selected properties remain available for the intended sequence: three nights near Cannon Beach with two queens, four nights in Yachats with a king and confirmed sofa bed, and one airport night with two queens. The Yachats total has increased, but all three rates remain cancellable and the combined increase is smaller than the cost of shifting the trip to the adjacent week.

events.continuity_hook: Retain the final round-trip flight and rental-car confirmations with totals for three passengers, baggage terms, pickup and return times, fuel and mileage terms, the route to Cannon Beach, and the final-night schedule near Portland airport.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two return schedules against the airport hotel and car-return timing, verify the complete transportation total, and book the flights and car.
events.scenario_brief: With lodging reserved, Marcus is ready to purchase the Chicago-Portland flights and rental car. The best outbound arrives early enough to reach Cannon Beach before dinner, while two return options differ by several hours; the later one avoids a very early airport departure but reduces the value of the final airport night, and the lowest car quote permits the coastal mileage but has a shorter grace period for the morning return.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the existing flight, car, Cannon Beach, and airport-hotel confirmations together with the Yachats room issue, the two-queen upgrade price, the Newport alternative's room and cancellation terms, and revised driving times for the central-coast days.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm the replacement room can accommodate all three travelers, compare its added cost with the Newport option and extra driving, and update the lodging reservation without disturbing the rest of the itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The Yachats property has informed Marcus that the reserved room's sofa bed will be unavailable during the stay because furnishings are being replaced. It can move the family to a two-queen room for a higher four-night total, while a previously considered Newport hotel has reopened availability at a similar total but would place them farther from two planned central-coast outings.

events.continuity_hook: Carry two workable flight patterns with arrival and departure times, airfare totals, estimated intercity driving, one-way rental fees, and the latest practical Wednesday departure into the hotel and car comparison.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the round-trip and open-jaw plans door to door, determine whether either allows travel on Tuesday morning, and select a flight structure without purchasing.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus needs to visit a restaurant outside Atlanta on Tuesday afternoon and another in Birmingham on Wednesday morning. He can fly round trip through Atlanta and drive between the cities, or book an open-jaw itinerary into Atlanta and home from Birmingham; the open-jaw fare is higher but avoids returning the rental car in Atlanta after Wednesday's inspection.
